mapper.select:
select s.id, s.stock_date, s.mix_area, s.glue, s.stock_num, s.remark, s.del_flag, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.bar_code, s.valid_time, s.stock_weight, p.RETURN_WEIGHT from t_fh_glue_stock s LEFT JOIN (SELECT concat(P.GLUE, '-F') glue, TRUNCATE(P.TOTAL_PLAN_QTY * RE.LOT_TOTAL_WEIGHT * R.RETURN_RATE / 100, 1) RETURN_WEIGHT, P.PLAN_DATE, P.MIX_AREA FROM T_GLUE_COLLECT_PLAN P INNER JOIN T_FH_GLUE_RETURN_RATE R ON R.MIX_AREA = P.MIX_AREA AND R.GLUE = P.GLUE LEFT JOIN (SELECT R1.RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME, R1.MIX_AREA, MIN(R1.LOT_TOTAL_WEIGHT) LOT_TOTAL_WEIGHT FROM T_MES_PMT_RECIPE R1 INNER JOIN T_MES_BAS_MATERIAL M ON M.MATERIAL_CODE = R1.RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE AND M.MAJOR_TYPE = '5' AND M.DEL_FLAG = '0' INNER JOIN T_RECIPE_TYPE RT ON RT.RECIPE_TYPE_CODE = R1.RECIPE_TYPE AND RT.DEL_FLAG = '0' WHERE R1.AUDIT_FLAG = '1' AND R1.RECIPE_STATE = '1' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_MES_PMT_RECIPE R2 INNER JOIN T_MES_BAS_MATERIAL M2 ON M2.MATERIAL_CODE = R2.RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE AND M2.MAJOR_TYPE = '5' AND M2.DEL_FLAG = '0' INNER JOIN T_RECIPE_TYPE RT2 ON RT2.RECIPE_TYPE_CODE = R2.RECIPE_TYPE AND RT2.DEL_FLAG = '0' WHERE R2.RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME = R1.RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME AND R2.RECIPE_EQUIP_CODE = R1.RECIPE_EQUIP_CODE AND R2.MIX_AREA = R1.MIX_AREA AND R2.AUDIT_FLAG = '1' AND R2.RECIPE_STATE = '1' AND CASE WHEN RT2.RECIPE_TYPE_NAME LIKE 'C2Z%' THEN 1 WHEN RT2.RECIPE_TYPE_NAME LIKE 'ZZ%' THEN 3 WHEN RT2.RECIPE_TYPE_NAME LIKE 'CS%' THEN 4 WHEN RT2.RECIPE_TYPE_NAME LIKE 'S%' THEN 5 ELSE 2 END < CASE WHEN RT.RECIPE_TYPE_NAME LIKE 'C2Z%' THEN 1 WHEN RT.RECIPE_TYPE_NAME LIKE 'ZZ%' THEN 3 WHEN RT.RECIPE_TYPE_NAME LIKE 'CS%' THEN 4 WHEN RT.RECIPE_TYPE_NAME LIKE 'S%' THEN 5 ELSE 2 END ) GROUP BY R1.RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME, R1.MIX_AREA) RE ON RE.RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME = R.GLUE AND RE.MIX_AREA = R.MIX_AREA WHERE P.DEL_FLAG = '0' ) P ON P.GLUE = S.GLUE AND P.PLAN_DATE = DATE_ADD(S.STOCK_DATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND P.MIX_AREA = S.MIX_AREA where s.del_flag = '0'
and s.stock_date = #{stockDate} and s.mix_area = #{mixArea} and INSTR(s.glue, #{glue}) > 0
order by stock_date desc,valid_time asc
order by ${orderStr}

merge into t_fh_glue_stock a USING (
select #{item.id, jdbcType=DOUBLE} id, #{item.stockDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} stock_date, #{item.mixArea,jdbcType=VARCHAR } mix_area, #{item.glue,jdbcType=VARCHAR } glue, #{item.stockNum, jdbcType=DECIMAL} stock_num, #{item.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR } remark, #{item.delFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR } del_flag, #{item.createBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR } create_by, #{item.createTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} create_time, #{item.updateBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR } update_by, #{item.updateTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} update_time, #{item.barCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR } bar_code,#{item.validTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} valid_time, #{item.stockWeight,jdbcType=DOUBLE} stock_weight
) b ON ( a.stock_date = b.stock_date and a.bar_code=b.bar_code AND a.del_flag = '0' ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE
a.stock_num = b.stock_num, a.remark = b.remark, a.update_by = b.create_by, a.update_time = now(), a.mix_area = b.mix_area,a.glue = b.glue,a.valid_time=b.valid_time, a.stock_weight=b.stock_weight
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( a.id, a.stock_date, a.mix_area, a.glue, a.stock_num, a.remark, a.del_flag, a.create_by, a.create_time,a.bar_code,a.valid_time,a.stock_weight) values ( get_sequence_nextval('seq_t_fh_glue_stock'), b.stock_date, b.mix_area, b.glue, b.stock_num, b.remark, 0, b.create_by, now(),b.bar_code,b.valid_time, b.stock_weight )
